findings.title: All env access goes through ConfigService
findings.message: The drizzle.config.ts file directly accesses process.env.DATABASE_URL without going through ConfigService. All environment variable access must be abstracted through ConfigService for validation at boot time.

claims.claim: The drizzle.config.ts file directly accesses process.env.DATABASE_URL without going through ConfigService.
claims.reason: The diff shows line 11 contains `url: process.env.DATABASE_URL ?? './data/local.sqlite',` which is a direct access to process.env.DATABASE_URL. This is visible in the PR diff and confirms the finding's assertion.

claims.claim: All environment variable access must be abstracted through ConfigService for validation at boot time.
claims.reason: The rule document explicitly states: 'Feature code must never read process.env directly. Add a typed property + validator on ConfigService and inject ConfigService where you need the value. ConfigService validates at construction so missing or malformed env vars fail at boot, not at first use.' This is a direct restatement of the rule.
